verdict.rationale: DBOS explicitly documents that Conductor's UI capabilities (pause/start/restart workflows, queue and schedule management) are also exposed via an OpenAPI-described HTTP API and the dbosctl CLI 'so you can script incident response and wire Conductor into your own tooling' (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-17), and a runtime probe confirms the OpenAPI spec is live and returns real schemas (dbos-probe-rt-4), plus dbosctl itself installs and runs keylessly (dbos-probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that literally every UI action (e.g. fork/replay) has a 1:1 API/CLI equivalent, and no evidence of dispute on this specific parity claim.
